title: Employee AI chat silently swallows request failures (409 'AI replies are paused' and network loss): no reply, no error, message box cleared
persona: founder@pawspace.in (also any staff with the tab)
steps: Sign in as founder, open /mobile-app, wait for welcome, open AI tab, pick customer 'Demo · Rahul Menon' (UATD-CUS-2-CRM)
Send 'Refund 500 rupees to this customer now' -> handoff reply shown (thread now owned by finance-cx)
Send 'Capture the pending payment' (or any message) -> POST /api/mobile-employee-ai returns 409 {error:'AI replies are paused while the conversation is owned by staff'}
Variant: with the POST aborted (Playwright route.abort / context.setOffline(true)) send any message
expected: The failure is shown to the staff user (alert or inline error) and the typed message is kept so it can be retried; /chat and /v2/chat already render the same 409 as a red alert and keep the text.
actual: The 'You' bubble is appended, the textarea is cleared, the Send button re-enables, and NOTHING else happens: no assistant bubble, no alert, no meta. employee-ai-mobile.tsx sets `error` in submit()'s catch but the main render branch never displays `error` (it is only rendered in the pre-bootstrap 'denied' branch). Reproduced 5 times: M2/M3/H2 (409) and offline-abort-send/setOffline-send (network) in 02-chat/result.json. Consequence: after ANY handoff (locally every first turn hands off because no provider key) the copilot appears dead for that customer and staff may re-send.
evidence: source: app/mobile-app/employee-ai-mobile.tsx (error state only rendered when !data)

title: AI Voice browser harness disabled locally: 'Cloudflare Workers AI binding (AI) is not configured'
steps: Open AI tab as founder; read the AI Voice State line; try Start voice
GET /api/voice-outbound?scope=ai_browser_test; POST {action:'uat_ai_browser_ticket'}
Open ws://host/voice/ai-self-test?mode=direct without a ticket (curl upgrade + in-page WebSocket)
expected: Readiness enabled:false with that reason, Start voice disabled, ticket refused 409 and audited, socket refused; staging with the Workers AI binding should enable it.
actual: State line: 'State: idle · Cloudflare Workers AI binding (AI) is not configured'; Start voice disabled (force-click no-op, no crash). GET readiness 200 {enabled:false, mode:'uat', deployment:'staging', approved:true, aiBindingConfigured:false, signingKeyConfigured:true, sampleRate:16000, reason:'Cloudflare Workers AI binding (AI) is not configured'}. POST ticket -> 409 {error: same reason} and security_audit_events row action=voice.ai_browser_test.ticket resource_id='blocked' outcome='blocked' detail.reason=same. WS upgrade without ticket -> 503 'Browser voice harness is disabled' (readiness gate runs before the 401 ticket check, so the 401 path is unreachable locally); in-page WebSocket closes code 1006; /voice/ai-self-test (carrier stream) without ticket -> 401 'Unauthorized AgentStream request'; plain GET -> 426. /team/voice/ai-test: 'Test via Browser Mic' disabled with the same reason. NOT testable locally: microphone permission prompt, start/stop session, STT->AI->TTS, listening/speaking/error states, ticket 401/409-reuse paths. Staging has: wrangler.toml [ai] binding='AI'; scripts/stage-config.mjs sets PAWSPACE_VOICE_ENV=uat and PAWSPACE_VOICE_UAT_AI_SELF_TEST_APPROVED=true; HTTPS origin (issueDirectBrowserVoiceTicket refuses non-https origins with 409 'Browser voice harness requires an HTTPS UAT origin'); PAWSPACE_UAT_SIGNING_KEY >= 32 chars.
evidence: curl: 503 'Browser voice harness is disabled' / 401 'Unauthorized AgentStream request' / 426
